meaning:
1) to go, to go away, to go about
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to go away
1a2) to go about
1a3) to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated
1b) (Pual) to go to and fro

elsewhere.note: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that there is no one remaining, shut up or left…
Then Saul said to his servant, “But, behold, if we go, what should we bring the man? For the bread is spent in our sacks, and there is not a present to bring…
As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,
“It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.
Why do you go about so much to change your ways? You will be ashamed of Egypt also, as you were ashamed of Assyria.
